title_en: The Longest Suspension Bridge in the World
grammar_focus: 被动语态各时态(is built / was designed / are sunk / has been estimated / had to be taken)+ 施动者 by,外加“consider / think / find / know / estimate + 某物 + to be”把 that 从句改写成不定式复合结构(was considered to be the longest / consider it to be elegant)(原创承载 NCE3 L17 考点·无需净化·纽约韦拉扎诺-纳罗斯大桥,连接布鲁克林与斯塔滕岛的巨型吊桥)
scene: 从布鲁克林一路向南开,很快就能看到纽约的一大景观——韦拉扎诺-纳罗斯大桥,一座连接布鲁克林与斯塔滕岛的巨型吊桥。多年里它被认为是地球上最长的吊桥。桥名取自意大利航海家乔瓦尼·达·韦拉扎诺——据说他早在1524年就驶入了纽约港。韦拉扎诺通常并不被看作著名探险家,可如今每天穿桥而过的千百万人都记得他的名字。大桥由工程师奥斯马·阿曼设计。主跨约4260英尺,长到建造时不得不把地球的弧度都算进去。两座近700英尺高的桥塔托起四根粗缆;桥塔本身立在深沉海底、由钢与混凝土浇筑的巨大平台之上。每根缆索由成千上万段钢丝拧成,整个桥面就悬吊在缆索之下。工程师估计,即使桥上塞满汽车,首尾相接,它承载的也不过是极限的一小部分。可尺寸并非一切:尽管无比巨大,韦拉扎诺却被许多人视为简洁而优美——正如设计者所愿,像一件在天空中“尽可能画得轻淡”的庞然巨物。

grammar_card.title: 被动语态 + consider/think sth to be
grammar_card.intro: ①被动语态“(主语)被…”:各时态都用“be 的相应形式 + 过去分词”——is built(现在)、was designed(过去)、are sunk、has been estimated(完成)、had to be taken(含情态)。②施动者(动作发出者)用 by 引出:designed by Othmar Ammann。③“by no means / of / from”别混:be made of steel(由钢制成)。④把 that 从句改成不定式复合结构:think/consider/find/know/estimate + 某物 + to be…——It was considered to be the longest(= It was thought that it was the longest);I find him to be honest(= I find that he is honest)。

rows: The towers are built on platforms.
was considered to be the longest

specialRules.rule: 被动语态由“be + 过去分词”构成,时态体现在 be 上:is built / was built / has been built / had to be built。
consider / think / find / know / estimate + 某物 + to be…,等于把 that 从句浓缩;被动时是 sth is considered to be…。
美语拼写:harbor(英式 harbour)、center(英式 centre);美语“高速公路”freeway(英式 motorway)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How is the bridge's roadway held up?
options: It is suspended from four great cables
It rests on many small pillars
It hangs from a single rope

passage: If you drive south out of Brooklyn, you soon see one of the great sights of New York: the Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge, a giant suspension bridge that joins Brooklyn to Staten Island. For many years it was considered to be the longest suspension bridge on Earth. It was named after Giovanni da Verrazzano, an Italian sailor who is said to have entered New York Harbor back in 1524. Verrazzano is not usually thought to be a famous explorer, yet his name is now known to millions who cross the water each day. The bridge was designed by an engineer named Othmar Ammann. Its main span stretches about 4,260 feet, and it is so long that the curve of the earth had to be taken into account when it was built. Two huge towers, which rise nearly 700 feet above the water, support four thick cables. The towers themselves are held up by enormous platforms of steel and concrete that are sunk deep beneath the sea. Each cable is made of tens of thousands of lengths of wire, and the whole roadway is suspended from them. It has been estimated that even if the bridge were packed bumper to bumper with cars, it would still carry only a fraction of what it can hold. Yet size is not everything. Despite its immensity, the Verrazzano is considered by many to be simple and elegant, a huge object drawn, as its designer hoped, as faintly as possible against the sky.

grammar_points.name: 被动语态 一般现在/过去(are built / was designed)
被动语态 完成/含情态(has been estimated / had to be taken)
被动 + by / made of(施动者与材料)
consider/think sth to be(被动+不定式)

stage5.stem: "The two towers ___ on huge underwater platforms."(被动:“被建在”)
stage5.stem_cn: 两座桥塔建在巨大的水下平台上。

stage5.stem: "The bridge ___ by an engineer named Othmar Ammann."(被动过去:“被设计”)
stage5.stem_cn: 这座桥由工程师奥斯马·阿曼设计。

stage5.stem: "The platforms ___ deep beneath the sea."(被动一般现在:“被沉入”)
stage5.stem_cn: 那些平台深深沉入海底。

stage5.stem: "It ___ that the bridge could carry far more cars."(被动完成:“据估计”)
stage5.stem_cn: 据估计,这座桥能承载多得多的车。

stage5.stem: "The curve of the earth ___ into account when the bridge was built."(被动含情态:“不得不被考虑”)
stage5.stem_cn: 建桥时不得不把地球的弧度考虑进去。

stage5.stem: "The whole roadway ___ from four great cables."(被动:“被悬挂”)
stage5.stem_cn: 整个桥面由四根大缆索悬吊着。

stage5.stem: "The bridge was designed ___ Othmar Ammann."(施动者用哪个介词)
"Each cable is made ___ steel wire."(“由…制成”用哪个介词)
"The bridge is admired ___ millions of drivers every year."(施动者用哪个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 每年有数百万司机赞叹这座桥。

stage5.stem: "For years it ___ to be the longest bridge in the world."(被动 + 不定式:“被认为是”)
stage5.stem_cn: 多年来它被认为是世界上最长的桥。

stage5.stem: "Verrazzano is not usually ___ to be a famous explorer."(被动 + 不定式:“被认为是”)
stage5.stem_cn: 韦拉扎诺通常不被认为是著名探险家。

stage5.stem: "Many people consider the bridge ___ simple and elegant."(consider sth 后接不定式)
stage5.stem_cn: 许多人认为这座桥简洁而优美。

stage5.stem: "Engineers found the platforms ___ stronger than expected."(find sth 后接不定式)
stage5.stem_cn: 工程师发现这些平台比预想的更坚固。

stage5.stem: "We know the Verrazzano ___ one of the great bridges of the world."(know sth 后接不定式)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们知道韦拉扎诺是世界名桥之一。

stage5.stem: "They estimated the span ___ about 4,260 feet long."(estimate sth 后接不定式)
stage5.stem_cn: 他们估计跨度约有4260英尺长。

stage5.stem: "The distance a bridge stretches across is called its ___."(“跨度”用哪个词)
"A very hard building material made of cement, sand, and stone is ___."(“混凝土”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 用水泥、沙、石做的坚硬建材。

stage5.stem: "Something graceful and beautifully simple is ___."(“优美别致的”用哪个词)
